scoring_justification: MAPE of agent-computed thermodynamic descriptors against paper-reported Table 1 values, a direct recompute comparison. Omega values in the reference are based on the composition-averaged melting temperature T_m.

schema.description: Columns: Alloy (string), Cr_content (float), Delta_H_mix_kJ_mol (float), Delta_S_mix_J_K_mol (float), Omega (float), delta_percent (float), VEC (float).

outputs.description: Scored artifact: the computed thermodynamic descriptors for the six HEA compositions. The hidden checker recomputes the mean absolute relative error (MAPE) against the paper-reported values and awards partial credit based on MAPE.

output_contract.notes: Note: The stability parameter Omega in the paper was calculated using the composition-averaged melting temperature T_m = Σ c_i Tm_i, not room-temperature T=298 K. Scoring compares the agent's computed values to hidden paper reference values using mean absolute relative error (MAPE). Higher error reduces credit; the exact tolerance band is defined in the hidden grading specification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported reference values for thermodynamic descriptors (Table 1)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Table 1; these are the paper's published results for the same composition and formulas. Omega values were obtained using the composition-averaged melting temperature T_m.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published numerical values from the paper's Table 1, serving as authoritative gold for the reproduction task. (Omega values are based on composition-averaged melting temperature T_m).

steps.description: Compute mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) across all alloys and all five thermodynamic columns against hidden reference.
